notes.title: Base Blitz is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we’re thrilled to announce that Base Blitz is officially live on Steam! Dive into this action-packed, red-vs-blue capture-the-flag adventure where strategy meets chaos. Gather resources, craft powerful tools and weapons, and lead your team to victory by infiltrating enemy bases, stealing their flag, and defending your own!
